uḷaṅga: [Ula+uka] (pu) CL=7 [Vi, Pi,dhāna. U+añca+ṇa] The ladle. See - Uḷuṅgabhikkhā. (2) A spoon or bowl to ladle water (such as a coconut shell). See also - Uluṅka, uḷuṅgabhikkhā.
uḷaṅka: [Ula+uka] (pu) CL=7 [Vi, Pi,dhāna. U+añca+ṇa] The ladle. See - Uḷuṅgabhikkhā. (2) A spoon or bowl to ladle water (such as a coconut shell). See also - Uluṅka, uḷuṅgabhikkhā.
uḷu: [U+lu+ṇa] (pu,na) CL=7 [Uccaṃ lavati gacchatīti ulu, so eva uḷu. Dhāna, ṭī. 57.] (1) Star or constellation. Asterism or lunar mansion. See - Uḷumpa.
uḷumpa: [Uḷu+pā+a] (pu) CL=7 [Uḷuto dakato pāti rakkhatīti uḷupo, so yeva uḷumpo. Dhāna,ṭī.665.] Raft.
uḷupa: [Uḷu+pā+a] (pu) CL=7 The moon (that protects or guards the constellations). See - Uḷupavaṇṇa.
uḷupavaṇṇa: [Uḷupa+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The appearance is like the moon"s appearance. Like the color of oil.
uḷurāja: [Uḷu+rāja] (pu) CL=7 The moon that is the master of stars and constellations.
uḷuṅgabhikkhā: [Uḷuṅga+bhikkhā]  CL=8 The alms which is as much as full of a ladle.
uḷuṅgayāgu: [Uḷuṅga+yāgu] (thī) CL=7 The rice porridge is as much as full of a ladle.
uḷuṅkasaddaka: [Uḷuṅkasadda+kara+kvi] (ti) CL=7 One who makes the sound of falling down the ladle or spoon. See - Uḷukaṃ.
uḷāra: [Ula+āra] (ti) CL=7 [U+dara+a. Sūci. U+ā+rā+ka. Kotthubha.] (1) Sweet. (2) Noble. (3) Vast or extensive.
uḷārabhoga: [Uḷāra+bhoga] (ti) CL=7 One who is very rich.
uḷārabhogakula: [Uḷārabhoga+kula] (na) CL=7 A family of vast wealth.
uḷāracchanda: [Uḷāra+chanda] (ti) CL=7 One who has noble desire.
uḷāracchandavīriyacittapañña: [Uḷāra+chandavīriyacittapaññā] (ti) CL=7 One who has noble desire, diligence, mind, and wisdom.
uḷāracitta: [Uḷāra+citta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a noble mind. See - Uḷāratta.
uḷāradesanāpaṭivedha: [Uḷāradesanā+paṭivedha] (ti) CL=7 One who understands or has insights into the noble teaching.
uḷāradibbabhoga: [Uḷāra+dibbabhoga] (ti) CL=7 One who has excellent Deva wealth.
uḷāradibbasampatti: [Uḷāra+dibbasampatti]  CL=9 The lofty happiness/achievement of a Deva/deity.
uḷāraguṇa: [Uḷāra+guṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who has excellent qualities.
uḷārajjhāsaya: [Uḷāra+ajjhāsaya] (ti) CL=7 One who has noble desire or one who inclines noble affairs.
uḷārakula: [Uḷāra+kula] (na) CL=7 (1) Noble race. (2) The family has a lot of power (governs, wealth, etc.,). See - Uḷārasambhāvita.
uḷārakulasambhūta: [Uḷārakula+sambhūta] (ti) CL=7 One who is being in noble race.
uḷārakulavacana: [Uḷārakula+vacana] (ti) CL=7 (Saddā) that explains the noble race.
uḷārakulūpapanna: [Uḷārakula+upapanna] (ta) CL=7 One who is possessed a noble family.
uḷārakāmaguṇasamannāgata: [Uḷārakāmaguṇa+samannāgata] (ti) CL=7 Full with an excellent object of sensual pleasure.
uḷārakāmarasa: [Uḷāra+kāmarasa] (pu) CL=7 The excellent defilement of sensual pleasure.
uḷārapaññā: [Uḷārā+paññā] (thī) CL=7 (1) The noble knowledge. (Ti) (2) One who has noble knowledge.
uḷāraphala: [Uḷāra+phala] (ti) CL=7 Has the benefit that is noble.
uḷārapāmojja: [Uḷāra+pāmojja] (ti) CL=7 One who is full of joy.
uḷārasadda: [Uḷāra+sadda] (ti) CL=7 One who has great reputation.
uḷārasambhāvita: [Uḷāra+sambhāvita] (ti) CL=7 Should be praised the noble person.
uḷāratamakulīna: [Uḷāratama+kulīna] (ti) CL=7 One who has a noble family.
uḷāratta: [Uḷāra+atta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a noble mind.
uḷāravaṇṇa: [Uḷāra+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who is extraordinary beauty.
uḷāraveda: [Uḷāra+veda] (ti) CL=7 One who is experiencing great inspiration.
uḷāravega: [Uḷāra+vega] (ti) CL=7 Has a lot of big waves.
uḷāraārammaṇa: [Uḷāra+ārammaṇa] (na) CL=7 The excellent object of the sense.
uḷārādhipati: [Uḷāra+adhipati] (pu) CL=7 Chief of many stars. The leader of the stars. The master of all-stars.
